row_granularity: One row per claim coverage segment, with separate rows possible for the same claim number by coverage type.
notes: The LOSS RUN DETAIL header repeats on continuation pages. Policy number and claim number share one column, and policy period is shown as a two-line date range. Date of Loss and claim status/closed date share one column, with the closed date positioned below CLOSED. Claimant name and coded claim description share one column; Accident Description is a separate narrative column. Financial fields use combined headers, including Reserves / Recoveries* and Gross Incurred / Net Incurred. The LOSS RUN SUMMARY on page 1 contains policy-period/LOB aggregate values, including Net Incurred. Detail rows use multi-line layouts, and Risk Location contains full addresses from which the state can be identified.
